This slice: Transform.

```plato

    // Apply a 3D homography. Precondition: no point of the shape maps onto the
    // plane at infinity.
    Transform(self: IDeformable3D, transform: Transform3D): Self
        => self.Deform(p => p.Transform(transform));

    // The concrete per-type `Deform` bodies live with the packages that own the
    // declarations, not here — the geometry primitives in `polygons.library.plato`
    // and `spatial-primitives.library.plato`, the meshes in `meshes.library.plato`,
    // the control-point curves and surfaces in `splines.library.plato` and
    // `surfaces.library.plato`.
    //
    // A type earns Deform when a mapped point set determines it completely. The
    // ones that look like they should but do not each carry a note at their own
    // declaration: InfiniteLine2D/3D and Ray2D/3D store a Direction, Circle,
    // Ellipse and RegularPolygon a radius, Wedge and Prism3D a sweep vector,
    // ConvexVolume a set of planes, and the Hermite splines their tangents. None
    // of those has an image under an arbitrary point mapping.
}
```
